facts.fact: 午餐时叙述者压下想告诉Quint某个『小女孩』记忆的冲动，只问Ben去向；Quint转述Ben一早外出继续侦探工作，并受托留守以防Gibbons来宅里找她。
facts.anchor: “He asked me to stay behind in case Gibbons got any ideas about trying to find you here.”
facts.relation: Ben＝叙述者同伙（对外以Mitchell兄妹示人，Kitty称其为她的哥哥）；Quint＝宅邸主人、Ben之友；Gibbons＝追踪叙述者的反派

facts.fact: Kitty与Florence到访图书馆时，Quint当着Kitty宣称叙述者已订婚以撇清嫌疑；叙述者当场回敬说婚约‘复杂’、自己未必会完婚，随后又抛出‘旧情人未忘情’的编造故事刺Quint。
facts.anchor: “It’s actually rather complicated,” I say. I want Quint to hear my honesty. “I’m not sure I’ll go through with it.”
facts.relation: Kitty（Miss Pratt）＝Quint的未婚妻；Florence＝Kitty的姐妹；叙述者对外被称作Quint家的‘老朋友’

facts.fact: 叙述者从书架抽出一排Jane Austen中的《Persuasion》，轻声朗读‘八年半前’的告白段落自况旧情，随后独自带书到树林池塘边的长凳上阅读。
facts.anchor: I offer myself to you again with a heart even more your own, than when you almost broke it eight years and a half ago.
facts.relation: 朗读内容暗示叙述者对Quint旧情未断（I have loved none but you）

facts.fact: Ben那晚与次日都未归，到第四天将尽时（Pratt姐妹晚餐后离开当晚）突然回到图书馆，自称此行侦察‘quite successful’，并要Quint确保无人打扰、闭门密谈。
facts.anchor: “I was quite successful,” he answers. He turns to Quint. “You ought to make sure no one disturbs us.”
facts.relation: Ben＝叙述者同伙、刚完成外线侦察归来；Quint＝配合清场的东道主
facts.number: the fourth day draws to a close

facts.fact: Ben从香烟盒夹层里取出手机向Quint展示，称之为‘portable telephone’；Quint第一次见到手机，目瞪口呆。
facts.anchor: He pulls out his cigarette case, laying his finger across the indentation on top so it opens, and pulls out his phone.
facts.relation: Ben＝来自未来、随身携带现代科技者；Quint＝1920年代人物、首次见手机

facts.fact: 三人同看手机里的照片与视频：Quint认出画面中的男人是Lord Bailemore——伦敦外交部高层、娶美国人、比国王还富；叙述者指出他1928年在纽约Plaza结婚，正是她与Quint此前交给Ben的名单事件之一。
facts.anchor: “Yes, of course. Lord Bailemore. He works quite high up in the Foreign Office in London—married to an American. And he’s richer than the king. What is he doing in New York?”
facts.relation: Lord Bailemore＝英国外交部高官、美国人之夫；Gibbons＝与Bailemore在纽约密会的反派；名单提供者＝叙述者与Quint

facts.fact: 视频记录Gibbons向Bailemore推销生物毒剂：一名妇女被当众灌服毒剂致死示威；Gibbons宣称数周内可灭伦敦人口、数月内灭全英格兰，解毒白药丸开价每片两万美元，Bailemore最终说‘Done’成交。
facts.anchor: No. The key to power I promised you is a biological agent so powerful I can wipe out the population of London in a matter of weeks—and all of England within months.
facts.relation: Gibbons＝出身特务的反派（曾对叙述者开枪射杀）；Bailemore＝出钱买毒的英国贵族；受害妇女＝被Gibbons手下拖入的演示品
facts.number: in a matter of weeks—and all of England within months；Twenty thousand dollars per pill

facts.fact: 结尾钩子：Ben宣布计划把Gibbons诱到Quint家、在他动手前将其送回未来，请Quint召集朋友在宅邸四周设严密警卫，并从外套里掏出一整包白色小药丸（‘Because I have these.’）。
facts.anchor: Ben pulls a package from his jacket and reveals a thick plastic package full of tiny white pills.
facts.relation: Ben＝设局者；Quint＝提供宅邸与人手；Gibbons＝被诱捕目标
